requirements.title: Add a "Forgot password?" link and reset page
requirements.detail: Show a "Forgot password?" link under the password field on Login. It opens a reset page where the user enters their email. The backend reset endpoint already exists; only the UI is needed.
requirements.source_quote: We need a "Forgot password?" link under the password field.

requirements.title: Show/hide password toggle
requirements.detail: The password field has a toggle to show or hide the password, as in the design.
requirements.source_quote: The show and hide password toggle in the design, do we have that already?

requirements.title: Show login errors inline under the field
requirements.detail: A wrong email or password shows an inline error in red text under the field instead of the top banner. The banner remains only for network errors.
requirements.source_quote: The design puts the error inline, right under the field, in red text.

requirements.title: Add a date range filter to the orders table
requirements.detail: Above the orders table, a filter with last 7 days, 30 days, 90 days and a custom range with two date pickers. Default is 7 days. The orders API call needs a range parameter instead of the hardcoded 7 days.
requirements.source_quote: We need a date range filter on top of the table: last 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, and a custom range with two date pickers.

requirements.title: Export orders as CSV
requirements.detail: An "Export CSV" button next to the date filter exports exactly the orders shown in the table for the selected range.
requirements.source_quote: And an "Export CSV" button next to the filter. It exports exactly what's in the table for the selected range. High priority, finance asked twice.

requirements.title: Empty state when there are no orders
requirements.detail: When there are no orders for the selected range, show an empty state with a short message instead of an empty table.
requirements.source_quote: Add an empty state with a short message.
